insight.title: One fragrance, told as a sequence of impressions
insight.takeaway: The simulated signal set points to a possible creative format: reveal one SERENITY fragrance through light, floral feeling and a warm, soft close. It is a mood-led story, not a verified note progression or a physical layering claim.

strategy.whyThisProduct: SERENITY is a verified Lavish product whose official description references citrus, floral and musk. A single-product, restrained editorial concept keeps the bottle identity legible and uses only those verified descriptors, without inventing note order, layering, ingredient or performance claims.

steps.explanation: The clean SERENITY original places the exact bottle and Lavish mark on a quiet ivory field at true aspect ratio, before any atmosphere is added. It is the fixed identity reference that every later frame must keep legible.

The lifestyle hero adds warm amber light and soft floral-inspired shadow as mood. The bottle mark stays fully visible, and the branch, stone and flower props are art direction rather than ingredient evidence.

The provided 10.08-second, 720×960 clip shows warm still-life, bottle-label close-ups and a return to the single-bottle setting. It is an independent provided preview, not a render of the 15-second four-shot concept script.

socialPosts.caption: SERENITY, by Lavish Perfumes. A quieter way to explore fragrance through light, floral feeling and a soft musk-inspired mood. Editorial concept for review; no verified application or performance claim.
SERENITY من Lavish Perfumes. تصوّر بصري هادئ يستلهم الضوء والإحساس الزهري ولمسة المسك في وصف العطر. مادة إبداعية للمراجعة، وليست وعداً بأداء أو نتيجة استخدام.
